description: This file defines token-related data structures and interfaces for the ANTLR parser generator, including token properties, token source pairing, and token implementation classes.

classes.name: Token
classes.description: Interface defining the properties and methods for a token in the lexer/parser.

classes.name: BaseToken
classes.description: Base implementation of the Token interface, providing common token properties.

classes.name: CommonToken
classes.description: Concrete implementation of Token, representing a common token with additional functionality.

classes.name: TokenSourceCharStreamPair
classes.description: Struct pairing a TokenSource with a CharStream.

methods.name: GetSource
methods.description: Returns the source pair of the token.

methods.name: GetStart
methods.description: Returns the start index of the token.

methods.name: GetStop
methods.description: Returns the stop index of the token.

methods.name: GetLine
methods.description: Returns the line number of the token.

methods.name: GetColumn
methods.description: Returns the column position of the token.

methods.name: GetText
methods.description: Returns the text of the token.

methods.name: SetText
methods.description: Sets the text of the token.

methods.name: GetTokenIndex
methods.description: Returns the index of the token.

methods.name: SetTokenIndex
methods.description: Sets the index of the token.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of the CommonToken.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the token.
